question: Between 1962 and 1990, which did most to raise trade between rich countries?
answer: The container. Bernhofen, El-Sahli and Kneller dated when each country got container ports or rail terminals and tracked its trade. Among rich countries, containers raised trade by several hundred per cent over 20 years, several times the effect of GATT membership or trade deals. Tariff cuts and boxes arrived together.
move: When two causes arrive together, ask which one you can date separately.
trap: Crediting the treaties, because trade policy is what gets reported.
source: Bernhofen et al., J. International Economics, 2016
reference: Bernhofen, El-Sahli & Kneller, Estimating the effects of the container revolution on world trade, Journal of International Economics, 2016
